scenario: What is the correct order of the Google Cloud resource hierarchy from top to bottom?
explanation: IAM policies and organization policies inherit down the hierarchy.

scenario: A new project needs to use the Compute Engine API. What must be done first?

options.text: Enable the API and link a billing account
Create a VPC peering connection to the default network
Request a quota increase for vCPUs in every region

explanation: Most paid APIs require an active billing account on the project.

scenario: Which command sets the default project for the gcloud CLI?

options.note: Not a valid way to set the CLI default.

explanation: Named configurations let you switch between projects and accounts.

scenario: A team wants a spending alert when a project reaches 80% of $1,000 per month. What should be configured?

options.text: A Cloud Billing budget with threshold rules
A quota limit on Compute Engine
An uptime check on the billing console
A log-based metric on billing log entries

explanation: Budgets alert but don't stop spending unless you automate it with Pub/Sub.

scenario: How can detailed billing data be analyzed with SQL?

options.text: Export Cloud Billing data to BigQuery
Download the monthly PDF invoice and import it

explanation: Standard and detailed usage cost exports are available.

scenario: Which IAM role type should generally be avoided in production because it's very broad?

options.text: Basic roles like Owner, Editor and Viewer
Service agent roles granted by Google services

explanation: Predefined roles give fine-grained access to specific services.

scenario: A user needs to manage only Compute Engine instances in one project. Which role is best?
explanation: Grant at the lowest level that meets the need.

scenario: Where should IAM roles be granted to give a group access to all projects in the Finance department?
explanation: Roles granted on a folder are inherited by its projects.

scenario: What's the recommended way to grant access to people?

options.text: Grant roles to Google groups, not individual users
Share one admin account among staff
Create service account keys for each person
Grant Owner to everyone temporarily, then remove it later

explanation: Groups simplify onboarding and offboarding.

scenario: Which service manages user identities for a Google Cloud organization without Google Workspace?
explanation: Cloud Identity can sync users from Active Directory with Google Cloud Directory Sync.

scenario: A project hit a limit on the number of vCPUs in a region. What should the admin do?
explanation: Quotas protect against unexpected usage and can be raised on request.

scenario: Which tool lets admins restrict resource locations to EU regions across all projects?

options.text: An organization policy with the resource locations constraint
An egress firewall rule blocking non-EU IP ranges
A VPC Service Controls perimeter only
A Cloud Billing budget per region

explanation: Organization policies are inherited down the hierarchy.

scenario: Which interface gives a browser-based shell with gcloud already installed?
explanation: Cloud Shell includes an editor and 5 GB of persistent home storage.

scenario: Which billing roles allow linking a project to a billing account?

options.text: Billing Account User on the account and Project Billing Manager on the project
Viewer on the project and Billing Account Viewer on the account
Billing Account Costs Manager on the account only
options.note: Manages budgets, but cannot link projects alone.

explanation: Billing Account Administrators can manage the billing account itself.

scenario: Which command installs additional components like kubectl for the gcloud CLI?
explanation: Package-managed installations use the OS package manager instead.

scenario: Which labels best help track costs by environment and team?

options.text: Key-value labels like env=prod and team=web on resources
Long resource names that include the date and team

explanation: Labels appear in billing exports for filtering.

scenario: Which Google Cloud AI assistant helps admins explore resources and troubleshoot from the console?

options.text: Gemini Code Assist in the IDE
options.note: Helps write code, not explore projects.

explanation: Gemini Cloud Assist can also query Cloud Asset Inventory.

scenario: Which IAM feature grants access only when conditions are met, such as until a certain date?
explanation: Conditions use attributes like time and resource name.

scenario: Which command creates a Compute Engine VM?
explanation: Specify --zone, --machine-type and --image-family as needed.

scenario: A batch job can be interrupted and restarted. Which VM option is cheapest?
explanation: Spot VMs can be preempted at any time.

scenario: Which resource defines the machine type, image and settings for VMs in a managed instance group?

options.text: A health check and backend service

explanation: Instance templates are immutable; create a new one to change settings.

scenario: Which managed instance group feature recreates VMs that fail an application health check?
explanation: Set an initial delay so VMs can boot before health checks count.

scenario: Which GKE mode manages nodes for you and bills per pod resource requests?
explanation: Autopilot applies Google's best-practice configuration.

scenario: Which command configures kubectl to access a GKE cluster?
explanation: This writes cluster credentials to your kubeconfig.

scenario: Which command deploys a container image to Cloud Run?
explanation: Cloud Run can also build from source with --source.

scenario: Which Cloud Storage class fits backups accessed about once a quarter?
explanation: Minimum storage durations: Nearline 30 days, Coldline 90, Archive 365.

scenario: Which command copies a local file to a Cloud Storage bucket?
explanation: gsutil cp also works but gcloud storage is recommended.

scenario: Which database fits a lift-and-shift of a MySQL app needing a managed regional database?
explanation: Cloud SQL supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server.

scenario: Which storage option gives a VM a high-performance block disk that can be resized and snapshotted?

options.text: Local SSD attached to the VM

explanation: Hyperdisk lets you tune IOPS and throughput separately.

scenario: Which VPC mode lets you choose your own subnet ranges in each region?

options.note: Creates one subnet per region automatically.

explanation: Subnets are regional; VPC networks are global.

scenario: VMs without external IPs must reach the internet for updates. What should be configured?

options.text: Cloud NAT on a Cloud Router
An ingress firewall rule allowing all

explanation: Cloud NAT provides outbound-only internet access.

scenario: VMs with only internal IPs need to reach Cloud Storage APIs. Which setting helps?

options.text: Private Google Access on the subnet
A public IP on each VM

explanation: Private Google Access is enabled per subnet.

scenario: Which load balancer distributes HTTPS traffic globally to backends in multiple regions?

options.text: Regional internal passthrough Network Load Balancer

explanation: It uses a single anycast IP address.

scenario: Which load balancer handles internal TCP traffic between tiers in one region without proxying?

options.text: Regional internal proxy Network Load Balancer
options.note: Proxies connections instead of passing them through.

explanation: Passthrough load balancers preserve client IP addresses.

scenario: Several projects must use subnets from one central network managed by a network team. What should be used?
explanation: A host project shares subnets with service projects.

scenario: Which tool does Google recommend for infrastructure as code, now that Deployment Manager is retired?
explanation: Infrastructure Manager runs Terraform as a managed service.

scenario: Which BigQuery command loads a CSV file from Cloud Storage into a table?
explanation: Schema can be auto-detected with --autodetect.

scenario: Which messaging service decouples a web app from background workers?
explanation: Push and pull subscriptions are supported.

scenario: Which option deploys event-driven code that runs when a file lands in a bucket?

options.text: Cloud Run functions with a Cloud Storage trigger
A GKE DaemonSet that polls the bucket
A Cloud SQL trigger on an upload table

explanation: Eventarc routes events to Cloud Run services and functions.

scenario: Which Cloud SQL feature provides automatic failover to another zone?
explanation: HA uses a standby instance in a second zone.

scenario: Which connectivity option links on-premises networks to a VPC over the internet with encryption?
explanation: HA VPN offers a 99.99% SLA when configured with two tunnels.

scenario: Which GKE object exposes a set of pods at a stable internal IP address?
explanation: Service types include ClusterIP, NodePort and LoadBalancer.

scenario: A data team needs managed Apache Airflow to schedule pipelines. Which service fits?

options.text: Managed Service for Apache Airflow (formerly Cloud Composer)

explanation: Google renamed Cloud Composer in April 2026.

scenario: Which storage service provides managed NFS file shares for VMs and GKE?
explanation: Google Cloud NetApp Volumes is another managed file option.

scenario: Which command creates a GKE Autopilot cluster?

options.text: gcloud container clusters create-auto NAME --region REGION

explanation: Autopilot clusters are regional.

scenario: Which agent should be installed on Compute Engine VMs to collect memory metrics and application logs?
explanation: Ops Agent combines logging and monitoring collection.

scenario: Which feature alerts when a public website stops responding?

options.text: Uptime check with an alerting policy

explanation: Uptime checks run from multiple global locations.

scenario: Which Cloud Logging feature routes logs to BigQuery for long-term analysis?
explanation: Sinks can also route to Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub or other log buckets.

scenario: Which audit log type is always on and records administrative changes like creating a VM?

options.note: Off by default for most services.

options.text: Firewall Rules Logging on all rules

explanation: Admin Activity logs can't be disabled and are free.

scenario: Which audit log type must usually be enabled to see who read objects in Cloud Storage?
explanation: BigQuery Data Access logs are enabled by default.

scenario: A VM needs a backup every night with 14 days of retention. What should be configured?

options.text: A snapshot schedule attached to the disk
A machine image created by hand weekly
An instance template with a disk image

explanation: Backup and DR Service offers centralized backup management too.

scenario: How can a managed instance group roll out a new instance template with no downtime?

options.text: Start a rolling update with maxUnavailable set to 0
Delete the group and recreate it
Stop all VMs first, then change the template
Change the zone of the group

explanation: Canary updates can test a template on a subset of VMs.

scenario: Which command scales a GKE deployment to 5 replicas?
explanation: A HorizontalPodAutoscaler adjusts replicas automatically.

scenario: A Cloud Run service must handle traffic spikes but cap costs. Which setting helps?

options.text: Set a maximum number of instances
Increase the request timeout to 60 minutes

explanation: Minimum instances reduce cold starts but cost more.

scenario: How can traffic be split between two Cloud Run revisions to test a new version?

options.text: Create a second project for the new version
Change the container port on the new revision

explanation: Tags give each revision a test URL.

scenario: Which tool searches and filters log entries in the console?
explanation: Use the Logging query language to filter by resource and severity.

scenario: Which feature creates a metric from the count of matching log entries, like 'error' messages?
explanation: Alerting policies can use log-based metrics.

scenario: How long does Cloud Logging keep logs in the _Default bucket by default?
explanation: Retention can be configured on custom log buckets.

scenario: A Cloud SQL instance needs to recover data to 10 minutes before an accidental delete. What should be used?
explanation: PITR requires automated backups and binary logging (MySQL) or WAL archiving (PostgreSQL).

scenario: Which GKE feature upgrades nodes automatically with minimal disruption?

options.text: Recreating the cluster for each version

explanation: Release channels control how quickly new versions arrive.

scenario: Which command lists running VMs in the current project?
explanation: Add --filter to narrow results, e.g. status=RUNNING.

scenario: Which tool shows a historical inventory of all resources and IAM policies across projects?
explanation: Asset Inventory supports export to BigQuery.

scenario: Which service helps find latency bottlenecks across distributed requests?
explanation: Trace is part of Google Cloud Observability.

scenario: A disk is running out of space on a VM. What's the least disruptive fix?

options.text: Resize the persistent disk, then grow the file system
Move the VM to a new region

explanation: Persistent disks can be resized while attached.

scenario: Which feature in Cloud Monitoring groups alerts so the right team gets notified?
explanation: Channels include email, SMS, Slack, PagerDuty and Pub/Sub.

scenario: Which GKE feature adds nodes when pods can't be scheduled due to lack of resources?
explanation: Autopilot handles node scaling automatically.

scenario: Which Cloud Storage feature deletes objects older than 365 days automatically?

options.note: Retain deleted objects; do not delete old ones.

explanation: Lifecycle rules can also change storage classes.

scenario: A Cloud Run service returns errors after a new deployment. What's the fastest way to restore service?

options.text: Route 100% of traffic back to the previous revision
Delete the service and redeploy from scratch
Increase the memory of the new revision
Disable logging on the new revision

explanation: Revisions are immutable, making rollbacks quick.

scenario: Which service manages database fleets and recommendations across Cloud SQL, AlloyDB and Spanner?
explanation: Database Center surfaces health, security and performance issues.

scenario: Which dashboard shows Google Cloud incidents that affect your specific projects?
explanation: Alerts can notify you of incidents affecting your resources.

scenario: How can an admin SSH into a Linux VM using their IAM identity rather than managing SSH keys?

options.text: Copy keys into metadata for each user manually

explanation: OS Login ties SSH access to IAM roles and supports 2FA.

scenario: A VM needs to read from a Cloud Storage bucket. What's the recommended way to give it access?

options.text: Attach a service account with a storage role
Copy a user's password to the VM
Make the bucket public for the VM's IP range
Download a service account key to the VM

explanation: Attached service accounts get short-lived credentials from the metadata server.

scenario: Why should service account keys be avoided when possible?

options.text: They're long-lived credentials that can leak
They can't be used outside Google Cloud

explanation: Use attached service accounts, impersonation or Workload Identity Federation instead.

scenario: Workloads running on AWS need to call Google Cloud APIs without service account keys. What should be used?

options.text: A service account key stored in AWS Secrets Manager
Cloud NAT with a static IP

explanation: Federation exchanges external tokens for short-lived Google credentials.

scenario: Which role lets a user act as a service account (impersonate it)?

options.text: Service Account Token Creator or Service Account User

explanation: Impersonation avoids distributing keys.

scenario: How do GKE workloads best access Google Cloud APIs securely?

options.text: Node service account keys in each pod

explanation: Kubernetes service accounts map to IAM principals.

scenario: Which firewall rule direction controls traffic entering VMs?
explanation: VPC networks have an implied deny ingress and allow egress rule.

scenario: How can firewall rules target only web server VMs?

options.text: Use network tags or service accounts as targets
Apply them to the whole organization only
Use billing labels on the VMs

explanation: Secure tags with Cloud NGFW policies offer IAM-controlled targeting.

scenario: Which feature applies firewall rules across many projects from the organization level?
explanation: Policies are evaluated before VPC firewall rules.

scenario: Which service protects internal web apps by checking user identity before allowing access?
explanation: IAP TCP forwarding also secures SSH and RDP without public IPs.

scenario: Which service stores API keys and passwords for apps with versioning and IAM control?
explanation: Grant secretAccessor only to workloads that need each secret.

scenario: Which encryption option lets a company control its own keys for BigQuery and Cloud Storage?

options.text: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) in Cloud KMS
Disabling encryption at rest for the dataset

explanation: Customer-supplied keys (CSEK) are another option for some services.

scenario: Which approach temporarily grants elevated access that expires automatically?

options.text: IAM Conditions with an expiry, or Privileged Access Manager
Disabling audit logs during the change

explanation: Privileged Access Manager supports just-in-time access requests.

scenario: Which service limits data exfiltration from BigQuery and Cloud Storage to unauthorized networks?
explanation: Perimeters restrict access to Google-managed services.

scenario: A contractor needs read-only access to one bucket for a week. What's the best approach?

options.text: Grant Storage Object Viewer on the bucket with an IAM condition
Give them a service account key that expires

explanation: Signed URLs are another option for individual objects.

scenario: Which command grants a role to a user on a project?

options.text: gcloud iam roles create ROLE --project PROJECT --member EMAIL

explanation: Use groups instead of individual users where possible.

scenario: Which tool recommends removing unused permissions from principals?
explanation: Recommendations are based on 90 days of permission usage.

scenario: Which Cloud NGFW feature can block traffic to known malicious IP addresses?

options.text: Threat intelligence in firewall policy rules
Static routes to a null next hop

explanation: Cloud NGFW Enterprise adds intrusion prevention.

scenario: Which principle should guide role assignments for service accounts?

options.text: Grant Editor to every service account
Share one service account across all apps
Create keys for every service account

explanation: Use separate service accounts per workload.
